items.prompt: A circle has radius 9. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 45°, in terms of π.
choices: arc 81/8π; sector 9/4π
arc 9/8π; sector 81/8π
arc 9/4π; sector 81/4π
arc 9/4π; sector 81/8π

items.prompt: A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 75°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 76°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
A circle has radius 5. From an external point 13 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 18, because the tangent extends beyond the circle
12, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
12, because the tangent bisects the radius
8, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
